claims.evidence: No shutter-count screen or EXIF data shown; would need a photo of the shutter-count display from software or a test shot's metadata.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a body cap on the mount, not a lens at all – there is no lens in this listing to assess, so the claim misrepresents what is being sold.
Photo 2 shows only the battery compartment door, not the battery itself or a charger; no accessory photo provided.
Interior/service history cannot be assessed from exterior photos; would need service stickers, interior shots, or a receipt.

risks.risk: Actual shutter count may be much higher than claimed, affecting sensor/shutter lifespan.
risks.proof: Photo or screen-recording of the shutter count shown via Canon EOS Utility or a shutter-count checking tool/website using a test photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as high-use/unknown-shutter-count body, not as low-use.

risks.risk: Sensor or interior could have dust, fungus, or corrosion not visible from outside.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of sensor (with mirror lifted) and a test shot against a white/blue sky showing no spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as condition-unknown, assuming possible sensor issues needing cleaning/repair.

risks.risk: No lens is included despite the seller's claim referencing lens condition — buyer may wrongly expect a lens.
risks.proof: Clear statement/photo confirming whether a lens is included or the listing is body-only.
risks.if_unproven: Price strictly as body-only, no lens included.

risks.risk: Battery, charger, memory card, strap, box, or manual may not actually be included.
risks.proof: Photo showing the battery, charger, and any other accessories laid out together with the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only, no accessories included.

risks.risk: Buttons, dials, autofocus, and LCD may be non-functional or glitchy despite normal appearance.
risks.proof: Short video clip powering on the camera, cycling through menu, triggering autofocus, and taking a test shot.

risks.risk: Camera may have undisclosed repair history or non-OEM replacement parts.
risks.proof: Photo of any service stickers/seals near battery compartment or screws, or interior view.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown-repair-history, not as 'never repaired'.

proof_requests: Photo/video of shutter count via EOS Utility or a test-shot EXIF check
Photo of battery, charger, memory card, and any other accessories laid out
Video of camera powering on, menu navigation, autofocus operation, and a test shot
Close-up photo of sensor and mirror box for dust/fungus/corrosion
Clarification and photo on whether any lens is included, since none is shown
Photo of any service stickers or screws indicating prior repair
response.reason: The witness confirms a genuine Canon EOS 5D Mark II body, but shutter count, battery/charger inclusion, interior condition, and repair history are unverified or unverifiable remotely, and the lens claim contradicts the fact no lens is shown, so it must be priced at worst case (body-only, unknown shutter count, untested) pending the listed proofs.
